name: Manticore
descr: A legendary beast that has a human's face, lion's body, scorpion's tail, and dragon's wings.

data.motivesAndTactics: Bite, claw, pounce, riddle, swipe, swoop, trick

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Manticore can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Riddle Me This
features.text: The Manticore is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.

features.name: Winged
features.text: While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

features.name: Pouncing Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Manticore pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal **3d20+6** physical damage, and the target becomes _Shaky_ until they spend a Hope. While _Shaky_, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

features.name: Paralyzing Tail Spike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes **3d8** physical damage and becomes _Restrained_ until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Locking Jaws
features.text: When the Manticore succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).
